 Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said Iran’s response would be “devastating and severe” if US-Israeli attacks resume.
 The IRGC says three “rogue oil tankers travelling an unauthorised route” in the Strait of Hormuz have been hit by “explosions and severe fires”.
